en.t: 3 large eggs
Kosher salt and freshly ground white or black pepper
1 tbsp (15 g) unsalted butter

sk.t: hrubozrnná soľ a čerstvo mleté biele alebo čierne korenie

en.t: 1. In a medium bowl, beat eggs with a disposable plastic or reusable wooden fork just until last traces of white are mixed in; season with salt and pepper.

2. In a perfectly unscratched 20 cm nonstick skillet, melt butter, swirling over moderate heat, until fully melted and foamy but not browned. Add eggs and stir rapidly with fork, tines up, while shaking pan to agitate eggs; make sure to move fork all around pan to break up curds and scrape them from bottom of skillet as they form. Stop stirring as soon as eggs are very softly scrambled and creamy (but still loose enough to come together into a single mass), 1 to 2 minutes.

3. Using fork, gently spread egg in an even layer around skillet and scrape down any wispy bits around the edges. The top surface should be loose and creamy, but if it looks too liquid and raw, cook undisturbed for another few seconds. (If it still flows, you can swirl skillet to send loose egg to the edges, where it will set more quickly.)

4. Remove from heat, tilt skillet up by its handle, and, using fork, gently roll omelette down over itself until it is nearly folded in half. Using fork, push omelette to edge of skillet so that lower edge of egg begins to just barely overhang; use fork to fold overhanging edge of egg up, closing omelette.

5. Hold skillet right over plate and turn omelette out onto it. It should be almond- or cigar-shaped, with the seam on bottom; if it's not, lay a clean kitchen towel over it and use your hands to adjust its shape and position, then remove towel. Serve. (To make another omelette, wipe any eggy bits out of skillet and repeat.)

1. V strednej mise rozšľaháme vajcia jednorazovou plastovou alebo drevenou vidličkou len dovtedy, kým sa nezapracujú posledné stopy bielka; osolíme a okoreníme.

2. V úplne nepoškriabanej 20 cm nepriľnavej panvici rozpustíme na miernom ohni maslo a krúžime ním, kým sa úplne neroztopí a nespení, no nezhnedne. Vlejeme vajcia a rýchlo ich miešame vidličkou otočenou hrotmi nahor, pričom panvicou potriasame, aby sa vajcia hýbali; vidličkou prechádzame po celej panvici, aby sme rozbíjali hrudky a zoškrabovali ich z dna, hneď ako sa vytvoria. Prestaneme miešať, len čo sú vajcia veľmi jemne zrazené a krémové (no ešte dosť riedke, aby sa spojili do jednej hmoty), 1 až 2 minúty.

3. Vidličkou vajcia jemne rozotrieme v rovnomernej vrstve po panvici a zoškrabeme tenké okraje. Povrch má byť riedky a krémový; ak sa nám zdá príliš tekutý a surový, necháme ho ešte niekoľko sekúnd bez miešania. (Ak stále tečie, krúživým pohybom panvice pošleme tekutú časť k okrajom, kde stuhne rýchlejšie.)

4. Odstavíme, panvicu za rúčku nadvihneme, aby bola naklonená, a vidličkou omeletu jemne zvinieme samu cez seba, kým nie je takmer preložená na polovicu. Vidličkou ju posunieme k okraju panvice tak, aby spodný okraj vajca len trochu prečnieval; prečnievajúci okraj vidličkou preložíme nahor a omeletu uzavrieme.

5. Panvicu podržíme priamo nad tanierom a omeletu naň vyklopíme. Má mať tvar mandle alebo cigary so spojom dole; ak ho nemá, prikryjeme ju čistou kuchynskou utierkou, rukami upravíme tvar a polohu a utierku odstránime. Podávame. (Ďalšiu omeletu pripravíme tak, že z panvice vytrieme zvyšky vajec a postup zopakujeme.)

en.t: 1. Adjust oven rack to highest position and preheat broiler. Heat olive oil in a 20 cm nonstick skillet over medium high heat, until shimmering. Add shallot and cook until beginning to soften, about 3 minutes. Add garlic and continue to cook until softened, about 2 minutes longer. Add spinach and oregano and cook, tossing often until spinach is fully wilted and any water released by the spinach has cooked off, about 6 minutes total. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

2. In a large bowl, beat eggs and milk with a whisk until incorporated. Add feta and season with salt and pepper. Pour egg mixture over spinach then gently stir with a spatula to release the spinach from the bottom of the pan so that the eggs are in direct contact with the surface of the pan.

3. Cook until eggs are almost totally set, about 12 minutes, reducing heat if necessary to prevent burning. Place pan under the broiler until the top is set as well, keeping a close eye on it so it does not burn, about 2 minutes longer.

4. To release the frittata from the pan, loosen edges with a spatula. Place a dinner plate over pan, and holding plate firmly flip the pan over so the frittata releases onto the plate. Serve warm with toast and sliced scallions.

1. Mriežku v rúre dáme do najvyššej polohy a zapneme gril. V 20 cm nepriľnavej panvici rozohrejeme na stredne silnom ohni olivový olej, kým sa nezačne vlniť. en.t: 1. Preheat oven to 200 °C (fan 180 °C) for a more browned soufflé with a slightly looser center or 190 °C (fan 170 °C) for a more gently cooked soufflé that sets all the way through. Set oven rack in lowest position. Grease interior of a 1400 ml ramekin with softened butter. Add some grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, rotating ramekin all around so cheese sticks to every part of buttered surface; add more cheese if you don't have enough or discard any excess. Wipe rim of soufflé dish and transfer prepared ramekin to the refrigerator until ready to use.

2. In a small saucepan, melt 3 tbsp (44 ml) butter over medium-high heat (do not allow it to brown). Add flour and whisk to form paste. Continue to cook, stirring, until raw flour scent is gone, about 1 minute. Whisking constantly, add milk in thin, steady stream, or in increments of a couple of tbsp at a time, whisking thoroughly and getting into all corners of pan to maintain a lump-free texture. Sauce will initially become very thick, then get thin once all the milk is added.

3. Heat, stirring, until sauce comes to a simmer and begins to thicken slightly. Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring and scraping the sides and bottom of pan, until sauce is nicely thickened, about 3 minutes. Season generously with salt and pepper. Transfer béchamel sauce to a large heatproof mixing bowl and allow to cool slightly.
4. Whisk Dijon mustard (if using) and cayenne or hot sauce (if using) into béchamel. Then, while whisking constantly, work in egg yolks one at a time until thoroughly blended. Set soufflé base aside.

5. In a large mixing bowl, using a French whisk, electric hand blender, or stand mixer fitted with whisk attachment, combine egg whites with cream of tartar (if using) and beat until firm, glossy peaks form.

6. Add 1/3 of beaten egg whites to béchamel base and stir well until whites are thoroughly combined and soufflé base has a looser consistency. Mix in Gruyère. Using a silicone spatula, gently fold remaining beaten egg whites into soufflé base until just combined.

7. Remove soufflé dish from refrigerator and set on rimmed baking sheet. Scrape soufflé batter into prepared baking dish, filling it up to the inner ridge, not to the top (discard any excess). If desired, using an offset or other spatula, gently smooth and level surface of the soufflé batter.

8. Transfer soufflé to oven and bake until well risen and nicely browned on top, about 30 minutes at 200 °C (fan 180 °C) for less set and 35 minutes at 205 °C (fan 185 °C) for more set, and 35-40 minutes at 190 °C (fan 170 °C) for fully set.
9. Immediately transfer soufflé to table and serve before it deflates too much, scooping out portions onto each diner's plate.

Rúru predhrejeme na 200 °C (teplovzdušnú na 180 °C), ak chceme suflé viac opečené s trochu mäkším stredom, alebo na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C), ak chceme suflé pečené jemnejšie a stuhnuté v celom objeme. Mriežku dáme do najnižšej polohy. Vnútro 1400 ml suflé misky vymastíme zmäknutým maslom. Pridáme trochu nastrúhaného parmezánu a miskou otáčame, aby sa syr prichytil na celý vymastený povrch; ak syra nie je dosť, pridáme, prebytok vysypeme. Za stáleho miešania ju pražíme, kým nezmizne vôňa surovej múky, asi 1 minútu. Za stáleho šľahania prilievame mlieko tenkým rovnomerným prúdom alebo po niekoľkých lyžiciach, dôkladne šľaháme a zasahujeme do všetkých kútov hrnca, aby omáčka zostala bez hrudiek. Omáčka najprv veľmi zhustne, po pridaní všetkého mlieka sa zriedi.

3. Za stáleho miešania zohrievame, kým omáčka nezačne mierne vrieť a trochu hustnúť. Oheň stiahneme na minimum a za stáleho miešania a zoškrabovania stien a dna varíme, kým omáčka pekne nezhustne, asi 3 minúty. Výdatne osolíme a okoreníme. 4. Do bešamelu zašľaháme dijonskú horčicu (ak ju používame) a kajenské korenie alebo pálivú omáčku (ak ich používame). Potom za stáleho šľahania po jednom zapracujeme žĺtky, kým sa dôkladne nespoja. Základ na suflé odložíme.
5. Vo veľkej mise ručnou metličkou, elektrickým šľahačom alebo kuchynským robotom so šľahacou metlou vyšľaháme bielky s vínnym kameňom (ak ho používame) na pevný lesklý sneh.

6. Do bešamelového základu pridáme ⅓ vyšľahaného snehu a dobre premiešame, kým sa sneh úplne nezapracuje a základ nie je redší. Vmiešame Gruyère. Silikónovou stierkou jemne vmiešame zvyšný sneh, len kým sa nespojí.

2. Vajcia opatrne vyberieme z hrnca dierovanou lyžicou. Podávame ihneď, alebo ich preložíme do misy so studenou vodou a uložíme do chladničky najviac na 2 dni. Pred podávaním ich preložíme do misy s horúcou vodou a necháme 2 minúty prehriať. Ihneď podávame.
